title: First Light
poem_text:
The sky turns gold at break of day,
As night’s dark shadows fade away.
The quiet world begins to rise,
With gentle light across the skies.

title: The Patient Seed
poem_text:
A tiny seed beneath the ground,
Waits quietly without a sound.
With sun and rain, it starts to grow,
Though it takes time, it surely will show.

title: The Hidden Path
poem_text:
A narrow path through woods so deep,
Where secrets lie and shadows creep.
Each step ahead may seem unsure,
But courage helps the heart feel sure.

title: The Silent Snow
poem_text:
Soft white snow falls from the sky,
Covering the ground nearby.
No sound is heard as flakes appear,
A peaceful moment calm and clear.

title: The Busy Ant
poem_text:
A tiny ant moves grain by grain,
Through sun and wind, through joy and pain.
It never stops, it keeps its way,
Working hard both night and day.

title: The Drifting Cloud
poem_text:
A cloud drifts slowly through the blue,
Changing shapes as it moves through.
Now a ship, then a face so wide,
A moving picture in the sky’s tide.

title: The Lost Kite
poem_text:
My kite flew high into the air,
Then slipped away without a care.
I watched it drift beyond my sight,
A tiny dot in fading light.

title: The Old Bridge
poem_text:
An old bridge stands above the stream,
Holding stories like a dream.
Each step I take upon its floor,
Feels like walking through the past once more.

title: The Whispering Wind
poem_text:
The wind moves softly through the trees,
Carrying songs upon the breeze.
It tells a tale both old and new,
In gentle tones that pass right through.

title: The Climbing Hill
poem_text:
The hill is steep, the path is long,
My legs grow tired, yet I stay strong.
Step by step, I reach the top,
And see the world that never stops.

title: The Shining Star
poem_text:
One star shines brighter than the rest,
Guiding travelers on their quest.
Though far away, it lights the night,
A tiny spark with endless light.

title: The Broken Crayon
poem_text:
A crayon broke while I drew a line,
I thought it could not work just fine.
But still it colored bright and true,
Showing me what small things can do.

title: The Long Journey
poem_text:
Step by step along the way,
I travel far throughout the day.
Though the road is long and wide,
Hope and dreams walk by my side.

title: The Changing Leaves
poem_text:
Leaves once green now turn to gold,
A quiet story slowly told.
Seasons change as time goes by,
Like passing clouds across the sky.

title: The Quiet Strength
poem_text:
Not all strength is loud and clear,
Some are calm and free from fear.
In silent ways, we stand up tall,
Showing courage without a call.
